 They come from the "Zoo Academy of Fine Arts", a school famous for collecting vehicles named after animals. From now on, you'll have more chances to know them!

 White Tiger: Gains two new skills!
 "Relentless Pursuit": Summon a phantom to hunt enemies. Vanishes upon taking any damage.
 "White Curtain": Generates dense white fog around itself, reducing the vision of all vehicles.

 Fixed a bug in Raid Mode where pushing the AA vehicles out of their position and then destroying them would incorrectly count as completing the mission twice.

notes.title: The 1st anniversary of Multi Turret Academy!
notes.content:
Hi, Commanders! It’s Yulia~~ 
Today marks the 1st anniversary of Multi Turret Academy! We are really excited and super happy to see all the support you’ve given us over the past year. Without you, our game definitely wouldn't have made it this far!
So far, our game has gathered over 20,000 players! This means so much to us!

[previewyoutube=9J4JS3u4pv8;full][/previewyoutube]

Over the past 365 days, we’ve updated the game 205 times, with the version going from 0.7.0 to 0.8.43. Although we’re still a bit away from version 1.0, we’ve been pushing forward and making great progress!

Future Plans
The dev team initially planned to complete the game in 3 to 6 months, but... we underestimated both the expectations from you all and our own ambition! Looking at it now, this game is still far from perfect, whether from the tank, anime, or roguelike aspects.

So, we’ve decided to keep updating for another 6 months to a year, bringing you a more complete and exciting Multi Turret Academy!

Update Roadmap
We originally had a precise monthly update roadmap, but it seems plans don’t always go as expected (I’m sure you all feel the same!).
No worries, though! We’re constantly growing and improving as we develop, so please trust us, and we’ll make sure to fulfill all the promises we’ve made to you! Here’s what you can expect:

 Advanced Difficulty System: Each vehicle type will have multiple difficulty levels to choose from, and completing the highest difficulty will reward you with a rare vehicle!

 Events System: A little surprise during battles to make the experience even more exciting!
 Around 3 new maps and BOSS fights will be waiting for you before the official release!
 Controller and Steam Deck Support: Unlock more ways to play!

	
There’s definitely more exciting content coming your way in the future! Thanks so much for your ongoing support. We’ll keep working hard to bring you the best game possible!
If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to join the Discord community and share them with us~~

notes.title: 0.8.41 New Aiming System and new Vehicle: SU-76M!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!
In this update, we’ve focused on improving the vision system, addressing some long-standing issues that many of you have been discussing, such as:
[olist]
 The camera view was too close, making it difficult for long-range vehicles to take advantage of their range.
 The screen’s wide-top-narrow-bottom layout made it easy for players to be ambushed by enemies from off-screen.
 The fog of war lacked a clear purpose.
[/olist]
	
After discussing with players and giving it thorough consideration, we’ve made these changes to enhance the overall gameplay experience. Feel free to share your feedback after the update!

Update 0.8.41

 New Vehicle: SU-76M: The SU-76M is the infantry’s best friend, excelling at tank hunting and fire support. However, its armor is so thin that even a bush might offer better protection...
 New Aiming System: Press Q to enter aiming mode, focusing the camera on the direction of your mouse. For turretless vehicles, the hull will automatically rotate to align with the target direction.
 Vision System Improvements: While the overall vision range has been slightly reduced, buildings will no longer block your view, and you can now share vision with allies!
 “Open Top” Optimization: This attribute now directly increases vision range instead of camera height, with its effect boosted to 30%!

	
Enjoy the update, Commanders, and let us know what you think!

Today, I summarized the two most important issues from player's messages:
	1. Lack of challanges: Players have mentioned that the missions are too short, the overall experience is bland, and the AI enemies are dumb. 	2. Lack of progression: I'm glad that players are enjoying the weapon upgrade system that allows stacking affixs. However, I acknowledge that the current upper limits for weapon upgrades and hull upgrades are too low. I intend to remake these two systems to achieve my initial goal of making even the weakest chassis and turret viable until the end.
	
I aim to complete these goals as soon as possible. 
Next month, I will start allowing players to vote for new vehicles to be added. Please stay tuned!

notes.title: On the first day after the release of the early access version
notes.content:
There were more players than I had imagined, and I am extremely grateful for everyone's support! 
Today, I have been collecting feedback from players all day. I apologize if I missed any replies.
In summary, I have identified three major issues with the game:


 Short game flow: Now my top priority task is to reasonably increase the length of the gameplay.
 Imbalance: Currently, HE and HVAP shells perform well, but other ammunition types, hull upgrades, and most vehicles have average performance. Additionally, weapon upgrades have minimal impact on low-rank turrets. I'm trying to solve these issues now.
 Lag: I will make further optimization attempts in the coming days.


I apologize for these issues in the game, and I will now focus on resolving them.
